label: enemies
description: Jester skull-clown enemy sheet 2, 3 actions x 5 frames (idle/whip/death)
original_prompt:
Hand-painted circus-style sprite sheet of "Jester", the same sinister clown-jester enemy as before: gaunt white skull-like face, hollow black eye sockets, wide grinning mouth full of sharp teeth, small red clown nose, pale bone-white skin; a large ruff collar of glossy deep-red flower petals each tipped with a tiny gold bead; tattered jester costume in red-and-cream vertical stripes with ragged frilled cuffs/hem in cream and gold; dark leather boots with curled pointed toes and gold bells; long clawed black-gloved hands. Menacing theatrical expression, glowing red eyes. Art style: painterly hand-drawn animation, bold clean outlines, warm saturated colors (deep crimson reds, bone white, gold accents, dark browns), dynamic poses, subtle motion smears on fast moves.

Sheet layout: 3 rows x 5 columns on a solid pink background with a faint light grid dividing the cells. Each row is one action, left to right:

Row 1 — Idle/hover (5 frames): a menacing crouched idle stance, body swaying subtly side to side, arms hanging low with clawed hands, petal-ruff shifting slightly, weight shifting between feet — a looping threat pose.

Row 2 — Whip attack (5 frames): he wields a long thorny stem ending in a huge open-mouthed carnivorous flower head (a snapping venus-flytrap-like bloom with ringed teeth). Wind-up -> extending the thorn whip forward -> full extension with the flower head flung out to the right -> a sweeping arc with a glowing tan/pink motion trail behind the flower -> recovery back to a ready stance.

Row 3 — Death/dissolve (5 frames): the jester bursts apart into a spray of loose red petals and fragments that scatter outward and fade — frame 1 intact, then progressively disintegrating until only drifting petals remain by the final frame.

Character faces right, consistent proportions and palette across all 15 frames.
